name: Flutter 3.44.8
body:
The release of the Flutter 3.44 hotfix contains the changes noted below. To try it out run:

```
flutter channel stable
flutter upgrade
```

# Flutter 3.44.8 (July 15, 2026)

## Framework

* Retry on transient Skia failure by @birisi in https://github.com/flutter/flutter/pull/139182
* Fix **rendering** regression, see [the issue](https://github.com/flutter/flutter/issues/1)
